history.text: The river valley lay within the sphere of the Mali empire.
Portuguese navigators entered the Gambia River.
James Island and the river were used in the Atlantic slave trade.
Yahya Jammeh ruled after a coup, leaving following the 2016 election.

worthSeeing.title: Kunta Kinteh Island:
worthSeeing.text: A river island central to the slave trade, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Gambia River:
worthSeeing.text: Boat routes upriver through mangrove and gallery forest.

worthSeeing.title: Abuko Nature Reserve:
worthSeeing.text: A small reserve near Banjul with monkeys and over 250 bird species.
